notes.title: 3-step Cloud TPU mini-course, scroll stage transitions & project code blueprints
notes.summary: Splits Phase 19 into three 2-lesson Cloud TPU courses (Phases 19, 20, 21), adds visual stage and era transitions while scrolling, and adds full project explanations with explicit code placement blueprints.
changes: Split the Cloud TPU onboarding track into three focused 2-lesson courses (~45 minutes each): 19 TPU Setup: Provisioning & Runtime Verification (tpu-01, tpu-04), 20 TPU Workflows: Launching Jobs & Checkpointed Experiments (tpu-02, tpu-05), and 21 TPU Systems: Generations, Memory, Precision & XProf (tpu-03, tpu-06).
Added course-type UI/UX cues (courseTypeCue), a sticky course section scroll bar, and five curriculum era transition banners across the catalog, phase guides, and pathways.

Grouped lesson reader sections into five color-coded learning stages (1 Understand, 2 Build & Run, 3 Experiment, 4 Exercise & Check, 5 Evidence) with a sticky scroll-aware stage bar and dedicated exercise workbench.

Added a full Project Blueprint at the start of every project workspace, guide, and catalog card explaining what to build, the exact workspaceFile where learners write code, the directory tree, and the stage verification workflow.

notes.title: TPU generations, precision and profiling
notes.summary: A practical TPU performance guide connects hardware choice, training and cache memory, precision error and profile interpretation to one decision report.
changes: Added a generation comparison from legacy TPUs through TPU7x, with primary sources, chip/device counting and training versus serving workload reasoning.
Added worked model-state, KV-cache and roofline estimates, plus explicit weight, activation, accumulation, optimizer and cache precision policies.
Added a bounded CPU/TPU precision lab comparing FP32, BF16 and true INT8 dots; recorded CPU error/storage figures retain source hashes and numerical checks.
Added short warmed XProf capture, timeline diagnosis and changed-shape exercises, linked from the TPU pathway, GCP guide and developer resources.
TPU execution, multi-host scaling and model-level quantization quality remain target qualification work.

notes.title: TPU and Google Cloud practice, plus a clearer course reader
notes.summary: A practical cloud workflow with a CPU-tested training launcher, and readable math and code in the downloadable HTML book.
changes: Extended the TPU pathway with Google Cloud project setup, gcloud provisioning, explicit backend checks, recovery, evidence retrieval and resource cleanup.

Added a downloadable launcher that reuses the workload-operations worker, rejects accidental overwrites and retains attempt history. CPU recovery and failure checks pass; TPU hardware qualification remains pending.

Improved the HTML course reader with syntax highlighting, code copy controls, expected-result panels, clearer equations and print styles. Embedded math fonts and styles preserve formatting when the HTML is saved.
Fixed shared syntax highlighting that dropped Python numeric literals containing underscores; added exact code-preservation checks across all 97 book chapters.
Added practical guides and launcher sources to release change detection.

Added feature-order and activation checks, retention gates, elementwise error budgets, nonuniform gradient parity, and fresh-interpreter export validation.
Expanded raw-request and artifact validation, packed-weight storage accounting, percentile interpretation and request deadline exercises.
